guitar.modelsText: Gibson Trini Lopez / Gibson ES-335 / Telecaster
guitar.notes: Dave Grohl's Gibson Trini Lopez/DG-335 signature is well known; entry accurate.

tone.target: bright arena crunch with tight chime and light grit
tone.profile: bright arena crunch with tight chime and light grit
tone.summary: A classic Brit rock setup using a mild overdrive for edge-of-breakup grit, paired with the UK 45 amp model and US Vintage 2x12 cab to achieve bright, punchy arena crunch. A light digital delay adds necessary space without washing out the rhythm.

rig.name: Foo Fighters - Times Like These - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up hum and background noise.
Provide clean edge-of-breakup crunch and light grit without heavy fuzz.
Bypass or use for subtle saturation if Green OD is insufficient (kept inactive).
blocks.gap: No specific distortion needed; the Green OD handles the required crunch.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the bright, punchy sound of a Plexi/Marshall-style amp head.
Provide a bright, focused cabinet sound suitable for arena rock.
blocks.gap: The target suggests 4x12 (Marshall/Plexi), but the US 2x12 offers necessary brightness and tightness while keeping the overall tone punchy and contained for FRFR.

blocks.purpose: Enhance upper mids and tighten the low end while maintaining brightness.
No wah effect required for this tone.
Add subtle space and depth without sounding washy or distracting.
Provide a subtle sense of space and arena size without excessive wash.

improvements.summary: Upgrade IR to better match the Marshall/Plexi aesthetic and provide more focused mid-range punch.

proposals.reason: The target tone suggests a Marshall/Plexi sound, which typically uses a 4x12 cabinet for full punch.
proposals.whenToUse: After initial testing of the GP-180 preset
proposals.expectedGain: Increased mid-range focus and perceived size.
